text:
ellie: Quick late-night poll: what's one SONG or one TV EPISODE you keep replaying at 2am? (Rules: single song or single episode only — no full albums/series)

bryan: Song: 'House of Jealous Lovers' by The Rapture. Instant energy jolt. :rocket:

mai: Episode: "Black Mirror" S1E2 (Fifteen Million Merits). Weirdly comforting? 

oscar: Oh man, underrated — Song: 'New Slang' by The Shins. Feels like small-town sunsets. :sunny:

rani: Episode: 'The Entire History of You' (Black Mirror S1E3) — one rewatch and you spiral then calm.

ellie: @rani love that one. also, shoutout to people who have a single-song loop to cook to — @bryan that's you, right? :joy:

bryan: guilty. also random rec: Song: 'Cherry-coloured Funk' by Cocteau Twins if you want dreamy late-night haze.

spotify-bot: Quick playlist suggestion: '2am Singles' created. URL: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/placeholder

noah: Episode rec: 'WandaVision' episode 5. Tiny, weird, comforting, then punches you. perfect single-episode hit.

mai: Also adding song: 'Night Drive' by The xx — immediate nighttime vibes.

ellie: ok this is great — I'll make a little collaborative playlist and a one-episode thread list for anyone who wants to bookmark. anyone want to volunteer to add notes (why it hits you at 2am)?

oscar: I will add notes for the songs — short one-liners.

rani: I can jot down episode beats for the TV ones.

ellie: sweet. new tradition: whenever someone mentions a late-night single, we add it to the thread list. thanks y'all. :heart:
